caption:
Could your LPG subsidy stop because of one missed check?

From 1 October, domestic LPG users need biometric Aadhaar authentication to book refills at the subsidised price.
Without it, you can still get a cylinder, but at the market price without subsidy.
It can be done when the cylinder is delivered, at the distributor, or on the oil company's app. If it's already done, you don't need to repeat it.
